verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents alert delivery to Slack (any channel, with in-Slack actions) and PagerDuty (incidents created on error activity), plus webhooks and other chat tools, which covers the destination half of the story. The evidence does not show any routing rules or trigger thresholds. Missing for 10: per-project/environment/severity routing filters, per-rule thresholds (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count), email notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration of alert configuration.
